name: Weekend House
character: A farmhouse quilt retreat with warm terracotta, generous photographic spaces, scalloped edges, and an unhurried invitation to sew and stay.

sections.title: A whole weekend. A little more quilt.
sections.subtitle: Bring your unfinished projects and your favorite people. We will make room for both.

sections.heading: Unpack. Settle in. Sew a little longer.

items.title: A table to spread out on
items.body: Leave the cutting mat out. Keep the blocks in order. Pick up exactly where you left off.

items.title: A slower sort of weekend
items.body: A walk, another cup of tea, then one more row. The schedule can leave space for you.

items.title: Your people, under one roof
items.body: A bee, a guild, or a few friends who have been saying “we should” for far too long.

sections.heading: Some projects need a change of scenery.
sections.html: Away from the laundry and the interrupted afternoons, a quilt starts to move again. A retreat gives you a place to spread it out, people to think alongside, and time that belongs to making. Imagine your weekend →

sections.heading: A few easy steps to getting away

items.title: Gather your people
items.body: Tell us your group size, preferred dates, and what you want from the weekend.

items.title: Make a plan
items.body: We confirm availability, room arrangements, access needs, and the full cost.

items.title: Bring the unfinished things
items.body: Pack your projects and usual tools. We send the house guide before you arrive.

sections.heading: A house guide, without the guesswork.
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: Describe the real sewing room, number of workstations, lighting, cutting and pressing areas, bedrooms, bathrooms, and shared spaces. Include room dimensions and clear access information.

sections.heading: A few things you might be wondering

items.a: Ask for the current room plan. Sleeping arrangements and any single-room supplements are confirmed before booking.
Please tell us your access needs. We will provide specific information about entrances, thresholds, bathrooms, and sewing-table arrangements before you decide.

sections.title: An itinerary with room in the margins.
sections.subtitle: A little structure, a lot of sewing, and permission to stop whenever the light outside looks good.

sections.heading: A weekend might look like this

items.title: Friday · Arrive and unfold
items.body: Set up your space, get to know the house, and make a gentle start after supper.

items.title: Saturday · Find your rhythm
items.body: A long sewing session, a proper break, and an evening of showing each other what changed.

items.title: Sunday · One more seam
items.body: A last quiet session, a photograph of the work, and time to pack without rushing.

sections.heading: Bring what makes sewing feel like yours.
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: Confirm your check-in and check-out times, meal arrangements, supplied tools, machine policy, and what guests should pack. The itinerary above is an example, not a booked package.

sections.label: Plan a weekend for your group

sections.title: Come with your circle. Or find one here.
sections.subtitle: Private group stays and hosted sewing weekends, each with room for good company.

items.title: Your own bee
items.body: Bring an established group and make the weekend yours. Ask about available dates and minimum group size.

items.title: A hosted weekend
items.body: Browse listed events for any open sewing retreats. Each listing sets out the schedule, inclusions, and registration terms.

items.title: A workshop stay
items.body: Ask about combining a group stay with a teacher-led session. Tutor availability and fees are confirmed separately.

sections.heading: Make this your own
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: List only retreat formats you actually host. Add bookable events through Events, with precise inclusions, capacity, prices, and cancellation terms.

sections.title: The details that make settling in easier.
sections.subtitle: Ask the practical questions now. Save your weekend for sewing.

sections.heading: A few things you might be wondering

items.q: Do I bring my own machine?
items.a: Confirm the equipment list before travelling. Bring your machine, power lead, foot control, and preferred tools unless your booking says otherwise.
Meal arrangements depend on the stay. Your written proposal lists catered meals, self-catering facilities, and any dietary arrangements.

items.q: Can I book the whole house?
items.a: Tell us your group size and preferred dates. We will confirm whether an exclusive group booking is available.
After availability, pricing, the booking agreement, and the required payment have been confirmed. Sending an enquiry does not reserve a date.

sections.heading: Make this your own
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: Add the actual cancellation terms, deposit schedule, parking, directions, quiet hours, pet policy, and emergency contact details.

sections.title: Let us put a weekend on the calendar.
sections.subtitle: Share your preferred dates, group size, and what would make this a good stay for you.

sections.heading: Tell us a little about your group.
sections.html: Include alternative dates if you can, room preferences, and any access or dietary needs. We reply with availability and a written proposal. Sample text — replace me: Add your current response time and booking contact here.
